opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com with followers, top repo, stars and latest post, then discard.
steps: Open GitHub search and type the username
Press Enter and click the Users results filter
Open mail compose and enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body with followers, top repo (stars, language), latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia lookup + company site Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an archive.org snapshot of their organization's website for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open archive.org Wayback and enter the domain
Click the target year and pick a snapshot date
Read the headline on the archived page
Create a new note with birth date, role, and the domain's archived headline
